name: Heading transform VTable prefix
description: Reconstructed entry names. The four slots and the target machine signatures are verified. The extent is a verified prefix.

name: gravityAcceleration
description: GravitySeaLevel is initialized by FUN_20bd0600 with a fallback of 32.174. A positive configured value can override it.

name: Published flight state IAT cell
description: Original import base for the fixed longitude words at +0x160/+0x164 and altitude words at +0x168/+0x16c.

name: Byte-fill IAT cell
description: The force collector calls this slot to clear the two 24-byte output vectors.

name: Force contributor adapter VTable

name: Base flight mass-change slot

name: Airplane mass-change slot
description: Reviewed slot +0xe4. The caller passes the flight object in ECX.

name: Helicopter mass-change slot
description: Reviewed slot +0xe4. The caller passes the flight object in ECX.

name: Engine type dispatch table

notes.title: Sim1 engine branch mapping
notes.description: The branch table maps the six aircraft.cfg engine types.

name: Propulsion moment blend divisor

description: Multiplier used by the turbine output helper.

description: Threshold used by the turbine output helper.

name: Airplane model VTable prefix
description: Verified eight-pointer prefix. The three displayed moment slots have independently checked caller and target signatures. Names are reconstructed.

notes.title: Normal airplane aerodynamic forces
notes.description: The producer calls the same three force targets in both configuration branches.

name: Propeller RPM to angular speed factor
description: Converts signed propeller RPM before applying the gyroscopic moment factors.

name: High-alpha longitudinal reference shift
description: Written by the airplane model input update and used in the force-transfer moment terms.

notes.title: High-alpha reference correction
notes.description: Filtered alpha drives two curves. Rudder, both high-alpha settings and realism scale the shifts.

name: High-alpha vertical reference shift
description: Written by the airplane model input update and used in the force-transfer moment terms.

notes.title: High-alpha reference correction

name: Airplane moment reference dispatch slots
description: Two slots in the airplane table at 20bbecd0. The targets forward to the configuration model.

name: Coefficient-model moment reference slots
description: Slots in the table at 20bc213c. The getters each load a float from the model to ST0.

name: Degrees to radians scale
description: Binary64 argument conversion for the angle-dependent moment curve.

name: Airplane coefficient-view getter slot
description: Slot +0x20 of 20bc2160 returns the coefficient view pointer from the model at +0x0c.

name: Moment coefficient model slots
description: Two verified entries of 20bc2618. The angle-driven lookup and the baseline are queried separately.

name: Mach interpolation knots
description: Seventeen 32-bit knots used by the Mach index producer. The last interval spans 4095 units.

name: Pitch Mach correction scale
description: Binary64 scale for signed 16-bit corrections from AIR records 0x420, 0x421, 0x422, 0x423 and 0x433.

name: Pitch-moment modifier weight
description: Binary64 constant for the optional modifier registered as 0xd07e.

name: Airplane elevator moment coefficient slot
description: Slot +0x5c of the coefficient model VTable at 20bc2618.

name: Airplane control-surface getter slot
description: Slot +0x118 of the airplane table at 20bbecd0. The target reads the pointer at airplane +0x334.

name: Elevator realism slope
description: Binary64 multiplier applied to the flight-dynamics realism weight.

name: Elevator realism offset
description: Binary64 bias added to the weighted realism value.

name: Airplane pitch-rate coefficient slot
description: Slot +0x60 of the coefficient model VTable at 20bc2618.

name: Pitch realism and control modifier weight
description: Binary64 factor for pitch-rate realism and for the control modifier loss in the pitch-rate and tail incidence coefficients.

name: Aerodynamic rate scaling quarter factor
description: Binary64 quarter factor multiplied by density, air-relative speed and geometry.

name: Airplane angle-of-attack rate coefficient slot
description: Slot +0x68 of the coefficient model VTable at 20bc2618.

name: Negative airflow-angle rate limit
description: Binary64 negative limit equivalent to -25 degrees per second.

name: Positive airflow-angle rate limit
description: Binary64 positive limit equivalent to 25 degrees per second.

name: Airplane horizontal-tail incidence coefficient slot
description: Slot +0x64 of the coefficient model VTable at 20bc2618.

name: Airplane elevator trim coefficient slot
description: Slot +0x6c of the coefficient model VTable at 20bc2618.

name: Control-surface modifier identifier
description: Identifier queried with registration value 0xd098 when populating the control-surface modifier at +0x0c.

name: Pitch coefficient slots +0x70 through +0x80
